# EMURU

EMURU v0.3.0 is meant to deliver the first usable conversational EMURU. It connects Telegram text messages to Hermes and the vault MCP for note retrieval and constrained Inbox writes.

Owner-only Telegram access, restart recovery and duplicate-message handling are release requirements. Model gateway fallback is introduced in v0.4.0.
